items.desc: AI 公司 Anthropic 上市在即，估值最高 1.5 万亿美元。

en: Anthropic has seen its value jump to as much as $1.5tn (£1.14tn) as its shares are set to start trading on the stock market on Thursday.
The artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the popular chatbot Claude said its shares will be priced at $83 each when it lists on the Nasdaq, a tech-focused stock exchange based in New York.
That will make it one of the most valuable companies in the world.
zh: 随着股票将于周四开始交易，Anthropic 的估值已飙升至最高 1.5 万亿美元（约 1.14 万亿英镑）。
这家人工智能公司开发了热门聊天机器人 Claude，它表示在纽约的科技股交易所纳斯达克上市时，每股定价为 83 美元。
这将使它成为世界上最有价值的公司之一。

en: Anthropic's stock market debut will make it the first US firm focused exclusively on AI to go public.
It will also mark a crucial test for the fast-growing industry, which faces questions over whether the huge amounts of money being poured into the technology will be profitable.
The firm said earlier this month it would offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each, which valued the company at up to $1.3tn.
zh: Anthropic 的上市将使它成为第一家专注于人工智能的美国上市公司。
这也将是对这个快速发展行业的一次关键考验，人们质疑投入这项技术的大量资金是否能带来利润。
该公司本月早些时候表示，将以每股 70 至 78 美元的价格发行股票，估值最高达 1.3 万亿美元。

en: But demand for Anthropic's stock debut — commonly referred to as its initial public offering, or IPO — is very high, according to one early investor in the company who spoke with the BBC on condition of anonymity.
The person said shares were more than 10 times oversubscribed ahead of the public listing, meaning demand for Anthropic shares exceeded the number of shares available.
If that turns out to be the case, Anthropic's valuation could quickly blow past its target on Thursday when trading begins.
zh: 但据一位要求匿名的早期投资者向 BBC 透露，市场对 Anthropic 首次公开募股（IPO）的需求非常高。
这位人士表示，在公开上市之前，股票的认购量已超过可供认购数量的 10 倍，这意味着需求超过了供应。
如果情况属实，Anthropic 的估值在周四开盘后可能很快超过目标。

items.desc: 英格兰将废除租赁产权制，公寓改为居民共同持有。

en: The government is to introduce new laws to scrap the way flats are built in England and Wales.
Under the proposed bill, most new leasehold flats will be banned and replaced with commonhold, where residents collectively own and manage their buildings.
Matthew Pennycook, the housing minister, said the current leasehold system was "blighting lives" and was an "anachronism in the twenty-first century".
zh: 政府将出台新法律，废除英格兰和威尔士现有的公寓建造方式。
根据拟议法案，大多数新建的租赁产权公寓将被禁止，取而代之的是共同持有制，即居民共同拥有和管理自己的楼房。
住房大臣马修·彭尼库克表示，现行的租赁产权制度正在“毁掉人们的生活”，是“21 世纪的时代错误”。

en: The legislation follows Labour's 2024 election manifesto to "bring the feudal leasehold system to an end" — with further details expected to be set out later.
However, freeholders argue the policy is "unjust" and will have a detrimental impact on investment markets.
The proposed Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill will also include capping ground rent — the annual fee paid by current leaseholders to their freeholder — at £250.
zh: 这项立法遵循了工党 2024 年竞选纲领中“终结封建租赁产权制度”的承诺，更多细节预计稍后公布。
然而，永久产权人认为这项政策“不公平”，将对投资市场产生不利影响。
拟议的《共同持有与租赁产权改革法案》还将把地租——即当前租赁产权人每年向永久产权人支付的费用——上限设定为 250 英镑。

en: That will then be reduced to a "peppercorn" rate — which is effectively nothing — after 40 years.
Fozia Malik lives in a one-bedroom flat in Oldham and says her ground rent will go up from £150 to £300 in January.
Malik says she would "never" buy a leasehold flat again, describing it as a "continuous torture cell".
zh: 40 年后，地租将降至“象征性”水平，也就是实际上等于零。
福齐娅·马利克住在奥尔德姆的一居室公寓里，她说自己的地租将于明年一月从 150 英镑涨到 300 英镑。
马利克说她“再也不会”买租赁产权公寓了，她把这称作“持续的折磨”。

items.desc: 梵高名画拍出 1.9 亿美元，创下艺术家拍卖纪录。

en: Auction house Sotheby's has sold a painting by Vincent van Gogh for a record $190.4m (£144.8m).
The sale of Châtaigniers en fleurs ("Chestnut Trees in Blossom") shatters the renowned artist's previous auction record of $117.2 million set in 2022.

The historic sale in New York on Wednesday comes after an eleventh-hour agreement was reached to resolve a dispute regarding claims the art piece was previously sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis.
zh: 拍卖行苏富比以创纪录的 1.904 亿美元（约 1.448 亿英镑）售出了一幅文森特·梵高的画作。
《花栗树盛开》的成交价打破了这位著名艺术家 2022 年创下的 1.172 亿美元拍卖纪录。
这场在纽约举行的历史性拍卖之前，双方刚刚在最后时刻达成协议，解决了有关这件艺术品在纳粹崛起时期被迫出售的争议。

en: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Van Gogh's life.
It is considered one of the most important works of art from that period to remain in private hands, according to Sotheby's.
The oil painting, which was estimated to carry a value of $180m (£136m) prior to the sale, was put up for auction as part of a set called the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection.
zh: 《花栗树盛开》创作于 1890 年，是梵高生命最后两个月的作品。
据苏富比称，它被认为是那个时期仍属私人收藏的最重要的艺术品之一。
这幅油画在拍卖前估价为 1.8 亿美元（约 1.36 亿英镑），是作为布拉基耶-阿列塔收藏系列的一部分进行拍卖的。

en: Representatives acting for heirs of the Fischer family had claimed the painting may have been sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis.

A lawyer for the family's heirs reportedly wrote to Sotheby's on their behalf, telling the auction house that the painting was sold in Amsterdam before World War Two because of financial losses the Fischer family's publishing company suffered under the Nazis.

"In recognition of the painting's complex Nazi-era history and the suffering endured by the Fischer family during the Holocaust, the two families have reached a mutually satisfactory resolution and the work will be sold pursuant to their agreement," Sotheby's said on Wednesday.
zh: 代表菲舍尔家族继承人的代理人曾声称，这幅画可能是在纳粹崛起时期被迫出售的。
据报道，继承人的律师曾代表他们致信苏富比，称这幅画在二战前于阿姆斯特丹出售，是因为菲舍尔家族的出版公司在纳粹统治下遭受了经济损失。
苏富比周三表示：“鉴于这幅画复杂的纳粹时期历史以及菲舍尔家族在大屠杀期间遭受的苦难，两个家族已达成双方都满意的解决方案，这件作品将根据他们的协议出售。”

items.desc: 克里米亚大桥本周第三次遇袭，交通暂时中断。

en: The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, a Russian official has said.
The Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, confirmed that traffic was temporarily suspended following another strike on the bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea.
The critical bridge had already been hit twice earlier in the week resulting in severe damage and part of the bridge collapsing into the water.
zh: 一名俄罗斯官员表示，克里米亚大桥本周已第三次遭到乌克兰袭击。
莫斯科任命的克里米亚领导人谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫证实，在这座连接俄罗斯与被占领的克里米亚的大桥再次遭到打击后，交通已暂时中断。
这座关键大桥在本周早些时候已两次遭到袭击，造成严重损坏，部分桥体坍塌入水。

en: The important infrastructure has long been targeted by Ukraine because of its significance as a logistical and symbolic asset to Moscow's war effort.
It comes as Russian President Vladimir Putin meets US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday for landmark talks in China.
Aksyonov confirmed the strike on the bridge in the early hours of Thursday via Telegram, adding that assessment of the damage was under way.
zh: 这座重要基础设施长期以来一直是乌克兰的打击目标，因为它对莫斯科的战争行动具有后勤和象征意义。
与此同时，俄罗斯总统普京将于周四在中国与美国总统特朗普和中国国家主席习近平举行具有里程碑意义的会谈。
阿克肖诺夫周四凌晨通过 Telegram 证实了这次袭击，并表示损失评估正在进行中。

en: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called the initial strikes on the Crimean Bridge as an "unprecedented operation" weeks in the making.
Ukraine used drones and missiles against it on 17 November which brought down a key section of the road.
In response, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov has said the bridge "will be rebuilt, and it will be even better than before".
zh: 泽连斯基总统称最初对克里米亚大桥的袭击是经过数周筹备的“前所未有的行动”。
乌克兰于 11 月 17 日使用无人机和导弹袭击了大桥，炸毁了路面的一段关键部分。
对此，克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫表示，大桥“将会重建，而且会比以前更好”。

items.desc: 孩子说谎不一定是坏事，可能是心理在发育。

en: When drawings appear on the wall or biscuits disappear from the tin, your child might blame the dog or claim there was a ghost — even if they are clutching crayons or covered in crumbs.
Children telling fibs is something most parents experience, but such dishonesty and deception is an important part of mental development.
"It's actually a skill that they're developing and that they will play with in order to get better," clinical psychologist Dr Jade Redfern tells the CBeebies Parenting Download podcast.
zh: 当墙上出现涂鸦或饼干从罐子里消失时，你的孩子可能会怪狗，或者说是有鬼——即使他们手里还攥着蜡笔、满身都是饼干屑。
孩子说谎是大多数父母都会经历的事，但这种不诚实和欺骗却是心理发展的重要部分。
临床心理学家杰德·雷德芬博士在 CBeebies 育儿播客中说：“这其实是他们正在发展的一项技能，他们会通过练习让它变得更好。”

en: Young children aren't quite sophisticated enough to lie, says Redfern, but they are capable of deception before the age of one.

One of the studies mentioned on the podcast comes from the University of Bristol, which found that around a quarter of children appear to understand some form of deception by the time they are ten months old.
Prof Elena Hoicka, who led the study, says it was fascinating to see how "surprisingly young" kids could be so adept and cunning, including her own.
zh: 雷德芬说，年幼的孩子还不够老练到会说谎，但在不到一岁时就已经会欺骗了。
播客中提到的一项研究来自布里斯托大学，研究发现，大约四分之一的孩子在十个月大时就已经能理解某种形式的欺骗。
主持这项研究的埃琳娜·霍伊卡教授说，看到孩子们如此“出乎意料地年幼”却又如此熟练和狡猾，令人着迷，包括她自己的孩子。

en: Hoicka says that the kind of deception a child uses from the age of two is quite basic — like pretending not to hear their parent or denying they've done something.
She says they also start to withhold information.
By the age of three, they have become much more proficient and creative in their deceptions, showing a deeper understanding of language and how other people's minds work.
zh: 霍伊卡说，孩子从两岁起使用的欺骗方式相当简单——比如假装没听见父母的话，或者否认自己做过某事。
她说，他们也开始隐瞒信息。
到了三岁，他们的欺骗变得熟练和有创意得多，表现出对语言和他人想法的更深理解。

items.desc: 调查称贝叶斯号船员事前不知道致命的大风风险。

en: The crew of the Bayesian superyacht did not know about a critical safety risk that left it vulnerable in powerful winds before it sank off the coast of northern Sicily, killing seven people, British investigators say.
British tech tycoon Mike Lynch, 59, and his daughter Hannah, 18, were among seven people who died when the vessel sank on 19 August 2024.

The sinking of the Bayesian unfolded with "extraordinary speed" when a violent downburst of freak hurricane-force winds knocked it onto its side in less than 15 seconds, the UK's Marine Accident Investigation Branch (MAIB) final report said.
zh: 英国调查人员表示，贝叶斯号超级游艇的船员不知道一个关键的安全风险，正是这个风险使游艇在大风中变得脆弱，最终在西西里岛北部海岸附近沉没，造成七人死亡。
英国科技大亨迈克·林奇（59 岁）和他的女儿汉娜（18 岁）是 2024 年 8 月 19 日船只沉没时死亡的七人之一。
英国海事事故调查处（MAIB）的最终报告称，贝叶斯号的沉没以“极快的速度”展开，一股猛烈的飓风级下击暴流在不到 15 秒内将船掀翻。

en: Safety information provided to the crew did not identify this type of risk, the MAIB said.
"It was very dynamic, very quick," said MAIB principal inspector Simon Graves.
"The speed of events overtook the crew and prevented them from taking any other action."
zh: 调查处表示，提供给船员的安全信息没有指出这种风险。
调查处首席检查员西蒙·格雷夫斯说：“一切都非常迅速，非常快。”
“事态发展得太快，船员来不及采取任何其他行动。”

en: The marine investigation found that the Bayesian "had a vulnerability to high winds that was not recognised, because the yacht had never been assessed at anchor with its sails down".
In addition, "the extreme winds that night were also not explicitly forecast, so the crew had no warning of the risk", Loder added.
With thunderstorms rapidly coming in, wind speeds went from 8 knots to about 70 knots (80mph) within minutes.
zh: 海事调查发现，贝叶斯号“对大风存在未被发现的弱点，因为这艘游艇从未在降帆锚泊状态下接受过评估”。
洛德补充说：“此外，当晚的极端大风也没有在预报中明确提到，所以船员对这一风险毫无预警。”
随着雷暴迅速逼近，风速在几分钟内从 8 节上升到约 70 节（每小时 80 英里）。
